description: This PHP source file defines the EndpointRule class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically in the EndpointV2 ruleset. It manages the evaluation and resolution of endpoint data based on input parameters, conditions, and templates within AWS endpoint rules configuration.

classes.name: EndpointRule
classes.description: Represents an endpoint rule, capable of evaluating conditions and resolving the endpoint URL, headers, and properties based on input parameters and ruleset standard library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EndpointRule with a definition array, extracting the endpoint configuration.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint configuration array associated with this rule.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Checks if the rule's conditions are met and resolves the endpoint if applicable.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the full endpoint details, including URL, properties, and headers, based on input parameters and standard library functions.

methods.name: resolveProperties
methods.description: Recursively resolves the properties attribute of an endpoint, handling template strings.

methods.name: resolveHeaders
methods.description: Resolves the headers attribute of an endpoint, processing each header's values.
